record.question: DF-41 - the most powerful intercontinental-range ballistic missile on Earth, belongs to which country?
record.explanation: DF-41 is a Chinese intercontinental ballistic missile, displayed in China’s October 2019 parade. China is the answer to the country question. The printed “most powerful on Earth” phrase has no stated ranking metric and is not being endorsed as a current technical comparison. Reference: https://eng.mod.gov.cn/xb/News_213114/TopStories/4852234.html. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
